# Science Sensei

> Science Sensei is an educational content platform exploring natural history, wildlife biology, ancient scientific methods, and fascinating scientific discoveries through engaging articles and visual storytelling.

The site features expert-written content covering animal behavior and adaptations, paleontology and human evolution, ancient scientific practices, space exploration, and technology history. Content is sourced from contributors like Joe Burgett and Monica Gray, with imagery from Wikimedia Commons and Shutterstock.

## Key Topics

## Wildlife & Animal Biology

- [37 of the Rarest Animals That Live Nowhere Else on Earth](https://sciencesensei.com/37-of-the-rarest-animals-that-live-nowhere-else-on-earth): Endemic animals and endangered species with isolated habitat biodiversity
- [Animals With Unexpected Defense Mechanisms](https://sciencesensei.com/animals-with-unexpected-defense-mechanisms): Unusual animal defense mechanisms including the hairy frog adaptations
- [These Animals Have the Strangest Defense Mechanisms in Nature](https://sciencesensei.com/these-animals-have-the-strangest-defense-mechanisms-in-nature): Unusual animal defense mechanisms like Iberian ribbed newt survival
- [These Interesting Physical Features Make These the Coolest Animals](https://sciencesensei.com/these-interesting-physical-features-make-these-the-coolest-animals-in-the-world): Unique animal adaptations featuring ribboned seadragon and marine life
- [These Animals Are Much More Dangerous Than You Thought](https://sciencesensei.com/these-animals-are-much-more-dangerous-than-you-thought): Dangerous animal behavior and unexpected wildlife safety awareness
- [These Dog Breeds Have Evolved to Be the Most Elite](https://sciencesensei.com/these-dog-breeds-have-evolved-to-be-the-most-elite): Dog breed characteristics and evolution including Afghan Hound guide
- [Why Saltwater Crocodiles Are the Scariest Reptile Alive](https://sciencesensei.com/why-saltwater-crocodiles-are-the-scariest-reptile-alive): Saltwater crocodile behavior and dangerous reptile wildlife safety facts
- [28 Facts About Northern White Rhinos That Will Break Your Heart](https://sciencesensei.com/28-facts-about-northern-white-rhinos-that-will-break-your-heart): Northern white rhino extinction crisis and wildlife conservation facts

## Human Evolution & Paleontology

- [Common Ideas About Neanderthals and Prehistoric Peoples That Aren't True](https://sciencesensei.com/common-ideas-about-neanderthals-and-prehistoric-peoples-that-arent-true): Neanderthal myths debunked covering human evolution and paleontology
- [Fascinating Facts the World Knows Thanks to Twin Studies](https://sciencesensei.com/fascinating-facts-the-world-knows-thanks-to-twin-studies): Twin studies revealing genetics, nature-nurture, behavioral patterns
